summary: Test suite covers basic unit test functionality (manifest parsing, license resolution, policy evaluation) but critically fails to meet explicit task requirements. MISSING: integration tests via `act` GitHub Actions pipeline (stated as mandatory with `act-result.txt` artifact); end-to-end scenario testing; behavioral verification (exit codes, compliance report output format); comprehensive manifest parsing edge cases (empty files, malformed JSON, version specifiers); and validation of referenced fixture files. Workflow.Tests.ps1 performs only structural YAML checks, not actual pipeline execution. Without `act`-based integration tests, the suite cannot catch regressions in CI/CD integration—a core task requirement. Unit test design is sound (good Pester structure, error handling coverage, fixture patterns), but execution against the GitHub Actions pipeline is entirely untested.
